The pre-ready barrier observes successful post-decode, post-stamp bounded admission and proves stale presence neither allocates an outer sequence nor forwards after bridge authentication.

The cumulative candidate tree is exact, the v3 delta is confined to server.rs, all focused and full sidecar tests pass, strict Clippy and formatting pass, and cached staged dependencies are unchanged.
